acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Cheektowaga Town NY PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.

overview:
Cheektowaga Town NY PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Cheektowaga Town NY PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Cheektowaga Town NY PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.

Community Impact

Violent Crime Suspects Located

Suburban Jewelry and Loan attempted armed robbery (05/01/2023, 1100 block of Walden Ave.) A suspect fired shots during an attempted armed robbery, exchanging gunfire with the store owner and an employee before fleeing. Flock camera data, combined with a witness description and New York State Police assistance, helped investigators narrow a vague vehicle description into a specific vehicle and license plate. The suspect, Jaquail A. Yamani, was later identified, charged, and pleaded guilty to all counts, including two counts of first-degree attempted robbery and criminal possession of a weapon.
